decision: Freeze Phase 5 as the operational automation baseline.
rulesAfterFreeze: Do not create a new Engine without proven need.
Do not create competing transversal systems.
Do not duplicate Manifest, Workflow or Playbook.
Reuse deliver-asset-end-to-end for supported new capabilities.
Apply incremental fixes to the existing mechanism.
Require new assets to prove reuse of the workflow.
Route new rules through the existing canonical model.
Phase 6 management panel is optional and does not block automated operation.
